note: Re-judged 2026-10-01 (BGP c12 judge). Records on session.go::detectCollision observed red both polarities. HEAD units in collision_test.go (direct detectCollision calls) stay supplementary. Ze holds at most one OpenConfirm connection per peer, so 'all' is that one.
